title: Finite separable extension from a trivializing datum
statement: Given a field $k$, finite commutative ring $\\Lambda$, sheaf $G$, a $LocallyConstantDatum\\ d$ for $G$, and finite constant module values on every member of the datum cover, there exist a finite separable field extension $K/k$, a finite $\\Lambda$-module $M$, and an isomorphism of the pullback of $G$ to $\\operatorname{Spec}K$ with the constant sheaf of value $M$.

proof.text: Choose a point on a cover member, use etaleness to obtain its finite separable residue field extension, factor the induced map through that member, and transport the finite constant trivialization along inverse-image composition.

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_field_finite_separable_constant_of_datum
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (d : LocallyConstantDatum G)
    (hd : ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology.over
              (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (K : Type u), ∃ (_ : Field K), ∃ (_ : Algebra k K),
      FiniteDimensional k K ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k K ∧
      ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        Nonempty
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).obj G ≅
            (constantSheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
